rectangular.en: We've got a big rectangular table in the kitchen where we all eat.
rectangular.zh: 我们厨房有一张大长方形餐桌,大家都在那儿吃饭。

oval.en: My favourite mirror is an old oval one that belonged to my grandmother.
oval.zh: 我最喜欢的镜子是一面老式椭圆镜,是我奶奶留下的。

triangular.en: We have a small triangular garden behind our house, full of flowers.
triangular.zh: 我们屋后有个小小的三角形花园,种满了花。

circular.en: We sat around a circular table so that everyone could talk easily.
circular.zh: 我们围坐在圆桌旁,这样大家都方便交谈。

cylindrical.en: My pencil case is a small cylindrical tin that I've had for years.
cylindrical.zh: 我的铅笔盒是一个用了多年的小圆柱形铁盒。

spherical.en: I bought a little spherical lamp that looks just like the Moon.
spherical.zh: 我买了一盏小球形灯,看起来就像月亮。

compact.en: My new camera is really compact, so it fits easily in my pocket.
compact.zh: 我的新相机很小巧,很容易放进口袋。

portable.en: I bought a portable speaker to take to the beach with my friends.
portable.zh: 我买了一个便携音箱,和朋友带去海滩用。

lightweight.en: This laptop is very lightweight, which is great because I travel a lot.
lightweight.zh: 这台笔记本很轻便,对我这个经常出差的人来说太好了。

bulky.en: My old suitcase was so bulky that I could hardly carry it.
bulky.zh: 我的旧手提箱太笨重了,几乎拎不动。

fragile.en: Be careful with that vase, because it's very old and fragile.
fragile.zh: 小心那个花瓶,它很古老,也很易碎。

durable.en: These boots are really durable, and I've worn them for ten years.
durable.zh: 这双靴子很耐用,我已经穿了十年了。

sturdy.en: We need a sturdy table, because the children are always climbing on it.
sturdy.zh: 我们需要一张结实的桌子,因为孩子们总爬上去。

smooth.en: I love the smooth feel of this old wooden box.
smooth.zh: 我喜欢这个旧木盒光滑的手感。

rough.en: The walls of the cottage are made of rough stone.
rough.zh: 这间小屋的墙是用粗糙的石头砌成的。

rough.en: I've got a rough idea of where I'd like to go next summer.
rough.zh: 我对明年夏天想去哪里有个大致的想法。

transparent.en: I keep my photos in a transparent box so that I can see them.
transparent.zh: 我把照片放在透明的盒子里,这样就能看到它们。

shiny.en: I bought a shiny red bike with the money from my first job.
shiny.zh: 我用第一份工作的钱买了一辆闪亮的红色自行车。

colourful.en: I love the colourful houses along the seafront in my hometown.
colourful.zh: 我喜欢家乡海滨那些色彩丰富的房子。

vivid.en: I still have vivid memories of my first day at school.
vivid.zh: 我至今还清晰地记得上学第一天。

pale.en: The walls in my bedroom are painted a pale shade of green.
pale.zh: 我卧室的墙刷成了浅绿色。

beige.en: I've got a beige coat that goes with almost everything I own.
beige.zh: 我有一件米色大衣,几乎能配我所有的衣服。

navy.en: I usually wear a navy jacket to work, because it looks smart.
navy.zh: 我上班通常穿一件藏青色夹克,因为看起来很精神。

striped.en: My favourite shirt is an old blue and white striped one.
striped.zh: 我最喜欢的衬衫是一件旧的蓝白条纹衫。

checked.en: My dad always wears a checked shirt when he goes fishing.
checked.zh: 我爸爸钓鱼时总穿格子衬衫。

leather.en: I've got an old leather bag that I bought in Italy years ago.
leather.zh: 我有一个多年前在意大利买的旧皮包。

cotton.en: I usually wear cotton shirts in summer because they feel so comfortable.
cotton.zh: 我夏天通常穿棉衬衫,因为穿着很舒服。

wool.en: My mum knitted me a thick wool jumper for the winter.
wool.zh: 我妈妈给我织了一件厚羊毛衫过冬。

silk.en: I bought a beautiful silk scarf for my mother when I was in Thailand.
silk.zh: 在泰国时,我给妈妈买了一条漂亮的丝绸围巾。

linen.en: Linen trousers are perfect for hot weather, but they crease easily.
linen.zh: 亚麻裤子很适合热天穿,但容易起皱。

ceramic.en: I bought a little ceramic bowl from a local artist on my holiday.
ceramic.zh: 度假时,我从当地一位艺术家那里买了一只小陶瓷碗。

porcelain.en: My grandmother has a set of fine porcelain cups she never uses.
porcelain.zh: 我奶奶有一套精美的瓷杯,她从来不用。

wooden.en: My grandfather made this little wooden horse for me when I was three.
wooden.zh: 我三岁时,爷爷给我做了这匹小木马。

plastic.en: I try not to buy drinks in plastic bottles these days.
plastic.zh: 现在我尽量不买塑料瓶装的饮料。

handmade.en: I prefer handmade gifts, because they show that someone really cares.
handmade.zh: 我更喜欢手工礼物,因为它们显示对方真的用心了。

machine-made.en: Machine-made furniture is cheaper, but it doesn't last as long.
machine-made.zh: 机器制造的家具更便宜,但没那么耐用。

exquisite.en: The temple has exquisite wooden carvings that took years to complete.
exquisite.zh: 这座寺庙有精致的木雕,花了好几年才完成。

delicate.en: I have to be careful with this delicate old necklace.
delicate.zh: 我得小心对待这条精致的旧项链。

decorative.en: These plates are just decorative, so we never actually eat off them.
decorative.zh: 这些盘子只是装饰用的,我们从不真正用来吃饭。

vintage.en: I love looking for vintage clothes in the little shops near my flat.
vintage.zh: 我喜欢在公寓附近的小店里淘复古衣服。

brand-new.en: I saved for a year to buy a brand-new laptop.
brand-new.zh: 我攒了一年钱才买了一台全新的笔记本电脑。

worn-out.en: These old trainers are completely worn-out, so I need a new pair.
worn-out.zh: 这双旧运动鞋完全穿破了,我得买双新的。

sentimental-value.en: This cheap old watch has great sentimental value because it was my father's.
sentimental-value.zh: 这块便宜的旧手表很有情感价值,因为它是我父亲的。

valuable.en: My most valuable possession is a ring that belonged to my grandmother.
valuable.zh: 我最贵重的东西是奶奶留下的一枚戒指。

priceless.en: My childhood photos are priceless to me, so I keep them safe.
priceless.zh: 童年的照片对我来说是无价的,所以我小心保管。

affordable.en: The restaurants near my university are pretty affordable for students.
affordable.zh: 我们大学附近的餐馆对学生来说挺实惠的。

pricey.en: That café is a bit pricey, but the coffee is really good.
pricey.zh: 那家咖啡馆有点贵,但咖啡确实很好喝。

value-for-money.en: The set lunch at that restaurant is really good value for money.
value-for-money.zh: 那家餐馆的午市套餐真是物有所值。

luxurious.en: The hotel was far more luxurious than anything I had stayed in before.
luxurious.zh: 那家酒店比我以前住过的任何地方都奢华得多。

carved.en: My parents have a beautifully carved wooden chest in their living room.
carved.zh: 我父母的客厅里有一个雕刻精美的木箱。

garment.en: That jacket is my favourite garment, and I've had it since I was eighteen.
garment.zh: 那件夹克是我最喜欢的衣服,我十八岁起就有了。

gown.en: My friend wore a long white gown at her graduation ball.
gown.zh: 我朋友在毕业舞会上穿了一件白色长礼服。

uniform.en: I had to wear a dark blue uniform when I was at school.
uniform.zh: 我上学时必须穿深蓝色的制服。

apron.en: My dad puts on a funny apron whenever he cooks for the family.
apron.zh: 我爸爸给家人做饭时总穿着一条搞笑的围裙。

collar.en: I don't like shirts with a tight collar, as they feel uncomfortable.
collar.zh: 我不喜欢领口紧的衬衫,穿着不舒服。

sleeve.en: I usually roll up the sleeves of my shirt when it gets hot.
sleeve.zh: 天热时我通常把衬衫袖子卷起来。

shawl.en: My grandmother always wore a warm woollen shawl around her shoulders.
shawl.zh: 我奶奶肩上总披着一条暖和的羊毛披肩。

cheongsam.en: My mother wore a red cheongsam at my cousin's wedding last year.
cheongsam.zh: 去年表姐的婚礼上,我妈妈穿了一件红色旗袍。

lace.en: My wedding dress had beautiful lace on the sleeves and around the neck.
lace.zh: 我的婚纱袖子和领口都有漂亮的蕾丝。

nylon.en: I've got a light nylon jacket that's great for walking in the rain.
nylon.zh: 我有一件轻便的尼龙夹克,很适合雨中行走。

cashmere.en: My aunt gave me a soft cashmere scarf for my last birthday.
cashmere.zh: 上次生日,我阿姨送了我一条柔软的羊绒围巾。

scarlet.en: She arrived at the party in a bright scarlet dress and silver shoes.
scarlet.zh: 她穿着鲜艳的猩红色连衣裙和银色鞋子来到派对。

ivory.en: I've got an old piano with yellowed ivory keys that belonged to my grandfather.
ivory.zh: 我有一架老钢琴,琴键是泛黄的象牙,是爷爷留下的。

amber.en: My aunt gave me a lovely necklace made of amber from Poland.
amber.zh: 我阿姨送了我一条来自波兰的漂亮琥珀项链。

khaki.en: I usually wear khaki trousers and a plain shirt when I go hiking.
khaki.zh: 我去徒步时通常穿卡其色裤子和素色衬衫。

lilac.en: We painted our daughter's bedroom a lovely shade of lilac.
lilac.zh: 我们把女儿的卧室刷成了可爱的淡紫色。

family-name.en: In my country, the family name always comes before the given name.
family-name.zh: 在我的国家,姓氏总是放在名字前面。

given-name.en: My given name was chosen by my grandfather and means 'bright'.
given-name.zh: 我的名字是爷爷取的,意思是“明亮”。

neat.en: I like to keep my desk neat, or I can't concentrate at all.
neat.zh: 我喜欢保持书桌整洁,否则根本无法集中精力。

cord.en: I keep tripping over the cord from the lamp in my bedroom.
cord.zh: 我老是被卧室台灯的电线绊倒。

bucket.en: When I was little, I'd take a bucket to the beach and collect shells.
bucket.zh: 我小时候常提着一个桶去海滩捡贝壳。

bundle.en: I found a bundle of old letters from my parents in the attic.
bundle.zh: 我在阁楼上发现了一捆父母的旧信。

texture.en: I like the rough texture of this old wooden table in my kitchen.
texture.zh: 我喜欢厨房这张旧木桌粗糙的质地。

scent.en: The scent of fresh bread always reminds me of my childhood home.
scent.zh: 新鲜面包的香味总让我想起童年的家。

odour.en: There's a strange odour in the kitchen, so I think something has gone bad.
odour.zh: 厨房里有一股奇怪的气味,我想是有什么东西坏了。

crisp.en: I love the crisp apples that we pick at my uncle's farm.
crisp.zh: 我喜欢在叔叔农场摘的脆苹果。

cloth.en: I use an old cloth to clean the windows in my flat.
cloth.zh: 我用一块旧布擦公寓的窗户。

clothing.en: I spend very little money on clothing because I don't care about fashion.
clothing.zh: 我在服装上花钱很少,因为我不在乎时尚。

belt.en: My dad gave me this leather belt when I got my first job.
belt.zh: 我得到第一份工作时,爸爸送了我这条皮腰带。

boot.en: I bought a pair of warm winter boots before moving to Canada.
boot.zh: 搬到加拿大之前,我买了一双保暖的冬靴。

mask.en: We wore masks and funny costumes to the party at the end of term.
mask.zh: 我们戴着面具、穿着搞笑的服装参加了期末派对。

perfume.en: I can always tell when my mum has been in a room from her perfume.
perfume.zh: 凭香水味,我总能知道妈妈是否来过这个房间。

jewellery.en: I don't wear much jewellery, just a watch and a simple ring.
jewellery.zh: 我不戴什么首饰,只有一块手表和一枚简单的戒指。

velvet.en: My grandmother's old sofa was covered in dark green velvet.
velvet.zh: 我奶奶的旧沙发上覆盖着深绿色的天鹅绒。

ornament.en: I keep a little glass ornament from Venice on my bedroom shelf.
ornament.zh: 我卧室架子上放着一件来自威尼斯的小玻璃装饰品。

rim.en: There's a small crack in the rim of my favourite coffee cup.
rim.zh: 我最喜欢的咖啡杯边缘有一道小裂纹。

glue.en: I broke the handle of my favourite mug, so I fixed it with glue.
glue.zh: 我把最喜欢的杯子把手弄断了,就用胶水粘好了。

patch.en: My jeans have a big patch on one knee, but I still love them.
patch.zh: 我的牛仔裤一条膝盖上有个大补丁,但我还是很喜欢它们。

knot.en: I'm hopeless at tying a tie, and the knot always looks terrible.
knot.zh: 我特别不会打领带,结总是打得很难看。

strap.en: The strap on my bag broke while I was running for the bus.
strap.zh: 我跑着赶公交时,包带断了。

fancy.en: We went to a fancy restaurant to celebrate my parents' anniversary.
fancy.zh: 我们去一家高档餐厅庆祝父母的结婚纪念日。

bustling.en: I love walking through the bustling market near my flat on Saturdays.
bustling.zh: 周六我喜欢穿过公寓附近熙熙攘攘的市场。

vibrant.en: What I like most about my hometown is its vibrant night market.
vibrant.zh: 我最喜欢家乡的一点是它充满活力的夜市。

lively.en: The old town is really lively in the evenings, with music everywhere.
lively.zh: 老城的晚上非常热闹,到处都是音乐。

crowded.en: I try to avoid the crowded shops in the city centre at weekends.
crowded.zh: 周末我尽量避开市中心拥挤的商店。

peaceful.en: My grandparents live in a peaceful village surrounded by rice fields.
peaceful.zh: 我的祖父母住在一个被稻田环绕的宁静村庄。

tranquil.en: I love sitting by the tranquil lake near my home after work.
tranquil.zh: 我喜欢下班后坐在家附近宁静的湖边。

serene.en: The temple garden is so serene that I always feel calm there.
serene.zh: 寺庙花园非常安详,我在那里总感到平静。

picturesque.en: We stayed in a picturesque village with old stone houses by a river.
picturesque.zh: 我们住在一个风景如画的村庄,河边都是古老的石屋。

scenic.en: We took the scenic route along the coast instead of the motorway.
scenic.zh: 我们走了风景优美的海岸路线,而不是高速公路。

breathtaking.en: The view from the top of the tower was absolutely breathtaking.
breathtaking.zh: 从塔顶看到的景色令人叹为观止。

spectacular.en: We watched a spectacular sunset from the beach on our last night.
spectacular.zh: 最后一晚,我们在海滩上看了一场壮观的日落。

magnificent.en: The palace was magnificent, with huge rooms and beautiful gardens.
magnificent.zh: 这座宫殿宏伟壮观,有巨大的房间和美丽的花园。

impressive.en: The new library in my city is a very impressive building.
impressive.zh: 我们城市的新图书馆是一座令人印象深刻的建筑。

historic.en: My hometown has a historic bridge that was built about 500 years ago.
historic.zh: 我的家乡有一座约五百年前建造的历史古桥。

historical.en: I enjoy reading historical novels, especially those set in ancient China.
historical.zh: 我喜欢读历史小说,尤其是以中国古代为背景的。

cosmopolitan.en: It's a very cosmopolitan city, with people from all over the world.
cosmopolitan.zh: 这是一座非常国际化的城市,有来自世界各地的人。

well-preserved.en: The old town is really well-preserved, and tourists love walking around it.
well-preserved.zh: 老城保存得非常完好,游客们很喜欢在那里漫步。

run-down.en: My old neighbourhood has become a bit run-down over the last few years.
run-down.zh: 过去几年,我以前住的社区变得有点破败了。

remote.en: My uncle lives in a remote village, and it takes all day to get there.
remote.zh: 我叔叔住在一个偏远的村庄,要花一整天才能到。

remote.en: I've been doing remote work for two years and I really enjoy it.
remote.zh: 我已经远程工作两年了,我真的很喜欢。

isolated.en: I'd feel too isolated living on a farm far from other people.
isolated.zh: 住在远离人群的农场,我会觉得太与世隔绝了。

well-connected.en: My area is well-connected, with buses and trains to the city centre.
well-connected.zh: 我住的地方交通便利,有公交车和火车通往市中心。

within-walking-distance.en: Everything I need is within walking distance of my flat.
within-walking-distance.zh: 我需要的一切都在公寓步行可达的范围内。

hometown.en: My hometown is a small city in the south, famous for its tea.
hometown.zh: 我的家乡是南方的一座小城,以茶闻名。

downtown.en: I live about ten minutes from downtown, so getting around is easy.
downtown.zh: 我住的地方离市中心大约十分钟,出行很方便。

city-centre.en: I don't usually drive into the city centre because parking is so expensive.
city-centre.zh: 我通常不开车去市中心,因为停车太贵了。

countryside.en: I'd love to live in the countryside when I'm older.
countryside.zh: 我年纪大了以后很想住在乡村。

seaside.en: We used to go to the seaside every summer when I was young.
seaside.zh: 我小时候每年夏天都去海边。

resort.en: We spent a week at a ski resort in the mountains last winter.
resort.zh: 去年冬天,我们在山里的滑雪胜地待了一周。

street-food.en: The best thing about visiting Bangkok was definitely the street food.
street-food.zh: 去曼谷最棒的事情无疑是街头小吃。

delicacy.en: This spicy fish soup is a local delicacy in my part of the country.
delicacy.zh: 这种辣鱼汤是我们这个地区的当地美味佳肴。

local-speciality.en: You really should try the local speciality when you visit my hometown.
local-speciality.zh: 来我家乡时,你真应该尝尝当地特产。

nightlife.en: The nightlife in my city is great, with lots of bars and live music.
nightlife.zh: 我们城市的夜生活很棒,有很多酒吧和现场音乐。

flourishing.en: There's a flourishing music scene in the city where I live now.
flourishing.zh: 我现在住的城市音乐氛围非常活跃。

birthplace.en: My hometown is the birthplace of a very famous Chinese poet.
birthplace.zh: 我的家乡是一位著名中国诗人的出生地。

foothill.en: We spent the afternoon walking in the foothills near my grandparents' village.
foothill.zh: 我们下午在祖父母村子附近的山麓散步。

border.en: My hometown is right on the border, so many people there speak two languages.
border.zh: 我的家乡就在边境上,所以那里很多人会说两种语言。

teahouse.en: My grandfather likes to meet his old friends at the local teahouse.
teahouse.zh: 我爷爷喜欢在当地的茶馆和老朋友见面。

villager.en: Every villager came out to welcome us when we arrived.
villager.zh: 我们到达时,每个村民都出来欢迎我们。

noble.en: Our local museum has a huge painting of a noble family from the past.
noble.zh: 我们当地的博物馆有一幅巨大的画,画的是过去的一个高贵家族。

unsophisticated.en: The food there is simple and unsophisticated, but it tastes really good.
unsophisticated.zh: 那里的食物简单淳朴,但味道很好。

surroundings.en: I work better in quiet surroundings, so I often go to the library.
surroundings.zh: 我在安静的环境中工作效率更高,所以常去图书馆。

haven.en: For me, the local park is a haven of peace in a noisy city.
haven.zh: 对我来说,当地的公园是喧闹城市中一处宁静的避风港。

splendid.en: We had a splendid view of the mountains from our hotel window.
splendid.zh: 从酒店窗户望出去,群山的景色壮丽极了。
